# Jeremiah 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-YHWH said — concerning faithless Israel and Judah in-the-land.

**2** "Thus says YHWH: 'Return — for I-have-spoken concerning the-house-of Israel and-the-house-of Judah.'"

**3** "Return, faithless Israel," declares YHWH; "I-will-not-look upon-you in-anger, for faithful I [am]," declares YHWH; "I-will-not-be-angry forever."

**4** Only acknowledge your-iniquity, that against-YHWH your-God you-transgressed, and-you-scattered your-ways to-the-strangers under every tree luxuriant, and-to-My-voice you-did-not-listen," declares YHWH.

**5** "Return, sons backsliding," declares YHWH, "for I am-master over-you, and-I-will-take-you, one from-a-city and-two from-a-family, and-I-will-bring-you to-Zion."

**6** "And-I-will-give-you shepherds according-to My-heart, and-they-will-shepherd-you [with]-knowledge and-understanding."

**7** "In-those days, says YHWH, they-will-not-say again, 'The-ark-of [the]-covenant-of YHWH,' and-it-will-not come upon [the]-heart, and-they-will-not-remember-it, and-they-will-not-miss-it, and-it-will-not be-made again."

**8** "At-that time they-will-call Jerusalem '[The]-Throne-of YHWH,' and-all the-nations will-be-gathered to-it, to-[the]-name-of YHWH, to-Jerusalem."

**9** "I-said, 'How I-will-set-you among the-sons, and-give-you a-land-of delight, an-inheritance-of beauty-of beauties-of [the]-nations.' And-I-said, 'My-Father you-will-call-Me, and-from-after-Me you-will-not-turn.'"

**10** "Surely [as] a-wife acts-treacherously against-her-companion, so you-have-acted-treacherously against-Me, house-of Israel," declares YHWH.

**11** A-voice upon the-bare-heights is-heard, weeping, supplications-of [the]-sons-of Israel, for they-have-perverted their-way, they-have-forgotten YHWH their-God.

**12** "Return, sons backsliding — I-will-heal your-backslidings." "Behold-us, we-come to-You, for You [are] YHWH our-God."

**13** "Surely for-falsehood [is] from-the-hills, [the]-tumult upon-the-mountains. Surely in-YHWH our-God [is the]-salvation-of Israel."

**14** "And-the-Shameful-Thing has-devoured [the]-labor-of our-fathers from-our-youth — their-flocks and-their-herds, their-sons and-their-daughters."

**15** "Let-us-lie-down in-our-shame, and-let-our-disgrace cover-us, for against-YHWH our-God we-have-sinned, we and-our-fathers, from-our-youth and-until this-day, and-we-have-not-listened to-[the]-voice-of YHWH our-God."

**16** "Have-you-seen what faithless Israel has-done? She-went upon every mountain high and-under every tree luxuriant and-played-the-prostitute there."

**17** "And-I-said, after she-did all these-things, 'To-Me she-will-return,' but-she-did-not-return. And-her-treacherous sister Judah saw."

**18** "And-I-saw that for all [the]-causes for-which faithless Israel committed-adultery I-sent-her-away and-gave to-her [the]-document-of her-divorce, yet-her-treacherous sister Judah did-not-fear, and-she-went and-played-the-prostitute — also she."

**19** "And-it-was from-[the]-lightness-of her-prostitution that-she-defiled the-land, and-committed-adultery with the-stone and-with the-wood."

**20** "And-even in-all this her-treacherous sister Judah did-not-return to-Me with-all her-heart, but in-falsehood," declares YHWH.

**21** And-YHWH said to-me, "Faithless Israel has-shown-herself more-righteous than-treacherous Judah."

**22** "Go and-proclaim these words to-[the]-north and-say, 'Return, faithless Israel,' declares YHWH; 'I-will-not-look upon-you in-anger.'"

**23** "Only acknowledge your-iniquity, for against YHWH your-God you-transgressed."

**24** "Return, faithless sons — I-will-heal your-faithlessness." "Here-we-are, we-come to-You, for You are YHWH our-God."

**25** For thus declares YHWH concerning divorce metaphor: "I-YHWH have-spoken; it-shall-come-to-pass."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **3:1**: Opening formula for the faithless Israel and Judah oracle. Standard prophetic messenger formula.

- **3:12**: Central imagery of divorce metaphor — characteristic of Jeremiah's rhetoric.

- **3:25**: Concluding declaration formula — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH').

— EMET
